items.name: Trekking & Expeditions
items.description: Guided treks and expeditions across Nepal — from the Manaslu Circuit to Everest Base Camp. Small groups, licensed local guides, and itineraries built around safety and the real Himalaya.

items.name: Barbershop

items.name: Imports
items.description: Sourcing and importing quality goods into Nepal — reliable supply, fair pricing, and a growing catalog for local partners and retailers.
